name: auryn-kustomize
summary: Kustomize plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Render-free: parses kustomization.yaml into a Resource (overlay/base) that RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each ref its images: transformer sets (newName/newTag/digest), and DEPENDS_ON the base kustomizations it layers on (resources/bases/components). A deploy-kustomize enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s/terraform/helm onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.
